The '''Combat Settlement''' is a [[Locations|Location]] in the [[Hub Island|Hub]], focused on the [[Combat]] Skill.

{{ZoneText|&fBuy Combat Tools from the &cWeaponsmith &fand &cRosetta&f.|&fTalk to &cJax &fat the &3Archery Range &fto learn about bows and arrows.|&fLearn about &3Enchanting &fat the &3Library&f.|&fTalk to &cMaxwell &fat the &6Thaumaturgist &fto learn about &6Magical Power&f.}}

== Purpose ==
The '''Combat Settlement''' contains several attractions.

* {{NPCSprite|Rosetta}} and {{NPCSprite|Weaponsmith}} can be found here, the former selling early-game weapons and armor, and the latter selling a variety of swords and bows.
* {{NPCSprite|Jax}} can be found in the {{Zone|Archery Range}}, where the player can attempt higher levels of '''Target Practice''' in order to unlock better arrows.
* {{NPCSprite|Maxwell}}, {{NPCSprite|Jacobus}}, and {{NPCSprite|Ozanne}} can be found in the {{Zone|Thaumaturgist}}: here, the player learns about {{Accessory Power}}, [[Maxwell|Stats Tuning]], and [[Powers]], and can upgrade their [[Accessory Bag]].
* The {{NPCSprite|Librarian}} can be found in the {{zone|Library}} and teaches the player about {{Skill|Enchanting}}.
